metadata.title: COMDEX 1979 campaign and presentation
metadata.status: Accepted alternative-history campaign; demonstrations require qualification, not claimed measured results

messages.campaign: More room to work. More freedom to choose.
messages.abacus_2: Calculate once. Chart it. Print the documents.

stages.description: Adam: growing businesses need more capacity, less waiting and compatible choices.
Identical live calculated shaded-cube animation on Aurelia and Aurelia+, followed by identical Abacus recalculation and chart generation; present measured results.
Chart employee pay values; link fields to a payslip layout; preview employees and print the entire batch.
The head of independent BPI demonstrates BPI Payroll as the source of calculated values, documented file exchange and reconciled totals.
Demonstrate a focused information-management task using tested, implemented capabilities; no implied live cross-application integration.
Introduce the Compatibility Kit, reference adapters and diagnostics. Show an independent application implementation only after qualification; otherwise show clearly labelled engineering work.
BPI leadership joins participating peripheral/computer suppliers. Name products and distinguish shipping, qualified and prototype status.
Purchasing, existing-Aurelia upgrades, ongoing support and independent manufacturer participation; new hardware focus on Aurelia+.

speed_demonstration.workload: Calculate rotation, project vertices, determine visible faces, calculate shading and draw a fixed sequence of cube rotations live. No prerecorded animation or precomputed frames.
controls: Same executable and inputs on both machines, compatible with both
Same resolution, shading method, rendering settings and equivalent qualified display configurations; disclose unavoidable differences
Visible start countdown, elapsed time and completed-frame count
Fixed frame/rotation sequence completes the same amount of work; no silent frame skipping or quality reduction
Use a workload that fits both machines; demonstrate additional capacity separately
Both machines must finish correctly; publish results only after measurement
speed_demonstration.business_comparison: Same Abacus 2.0 executable, worksheet values/formulas, calculation settings and chart workload. Compare recalculation and chart-generation time; exclude physical printer time.
speed_demonstration.interpretation: Animation measures the combined calculation/display path, not pure CPU performance. The catalog clocks are 4 and 6 MHz, but no 1.5x or other application speedup is promised.

headline_features: Document layouts populated by spreadsheet field values
abacus_demonstration.chart_scope: Use the catalogued text-mode vertical or horizontal bar charts; do not imply unimplemented graphical chart types.
abacus_demonstration.data: Fictitious employees with names, departments, pay components, deductions and precalculated net pay; one row per employee.
steps: Inspect precalculated values and reconcile totals
Show a payroll-cost bar chart by department
Open one reusable payslip layout and identify linked spreadsheet fields
Preview different employees to show field substitution
Print one complete payslip per employee from the same layout
acceptance: Validate field mapping, missing values, numeric formatting and rounding
Validate pagination and ensure every selected employee prints exactly once with the correct values
Validate save/reopen and preserve spreadsheet/document contents
Reconcile BPI-exported values with source totals through documented versioned disk-file exchange
abacus_demonstration.boundary: Abacus charts, formats and prints supplied calculations. Payroll law/rules, statutory deductions and updates belong to the payroll application or properly maintained worksheet. No direct ledger write-back or live database link.
abacus_demonstration.sparse_storage: Supporting implementation advantage for useful workloads, not a permanently exclusive general technique.
abacus_demonstration.existing_owners: Promote Abacus 2.0 on both Aurelia and Aurelia+ in supported configurations. Do not imply a new computer is required.

partner_policy.bpi: Independent branding, management, licences and support. The head of BPI speaks immediately after Abacus and joins the partner segment.
partner_policy.peripherals: Demonstrate only individually qualified configurations. Invitations and targets are not agreements or shipments.
partner_policy.manufacturers: Published interfaces and kit permit independent Aurelia-class implementations; support and certification optional. Native hardware adapters are valid; FlexiBUS and Logix video are separate profiles. Proper application/OS/firmware licences remain necessary.

activities.activity: Confidential dealer/BPI training, demo qualification, workflow rehearsal and press-material preparation. Invite business buyers and manufacturers to separate sessions; do not disclose unreleased specifications or pricing publicly.

Trade-press demos and advertisements show side-by-side speed, charts and printed payslips. Press pack includes sample data/layouts, configurations and measured results. Paid broadcasting/celebrity promotion requires confirmed arrangements.
Business-workflow stations, existing-owner upgrade consultations, peripheral demos and manufacturer clinics. Each visitor gets a relevant next step.
Dealer roadshows and Academy sessions: From spreadsheet to finished documents. Follow up with demonstrations and quotations.
Manufacturer porting workshops and publication of verified configuration-specific compatibility results.

commercial_policy.new_buyers: Clearly price hardware, required software and printing configuration; separately quote BPI licences and specialist setup.
commercial_policy.existing_owners: New capabilities for the computer you already own. Publish configuration requirements and explain workloads that benefit from Aurelia+.
commercial_policy.manufacturers: Freely accessible specifications/self-tests, modest physical-kit pricing, optional bounded assistance and configuration-specific certification; no exclusive partnership required.
commercial_policy.suppliers: Interoperability sessions and verified directory listings; document production supplies a concrete printer use case.
commercial_policy.promotion: Prefer training, demonstration access and implementation help over another general price cut. Discounts, contracts and media spend are not invented.

strategy: Logix focuses new hardware development and promotion on Aurelia+ while enabling independent Aurelia-class clones and maintaining installed-base support; no immediate withdrawal date.

disclosure.permitted: Native binary compatibility will change; established C practices reduce migration work; a planned optional Z80 path supports qualified legacy code.
disclosure.withheld: No future product/processor/OS names, word size, architecture, future-target compiler output, binaries or revealing demonstrations before NCC 1980.

business: Delivered Aurelia+ systems and lead times
ecosystem: Applications qualified on named independent computers
metrics.counting: Track delivery and ecosystem progress separately. Kit registrations, prototypes, applications and certification submissions are not computer sales.

economics.status: Campaign, venue/AV, staffing, demo equipment, printing, press, travel and workshop budgets remain to be approved; no ROI claim.
economics.forecast_boundary: Public launch occurs after the November 30 sales cutoff. Confidential preparation adds no separately calibrated prelaunch uplift. Existing scenario values remain unchanged; later sales/cannibalisation require an explicit model.
